How many days until Ramadan?

See how many days are left until Ramadan or Eid from today, and your Ramadan working hours in your country.

Prepared and reviewed by the Mustahaqati team · Last updated: 2026-11-03

Countdown

Ramadan and Eid dates 1448 (2027)

OccasionHijriUmm al-Qura calendarAlternative
Start of Ramadan1 Ramadan 1448Monday 8 February 2027Sunday 7 February if the crescent is seen on 6 February (unlikely)
Eid al-Fitr1 Shawwal 1448Tuesday 9 March 2027Wednesday 10 March if Ramadan completes 30 days
Day of Arafat9 Dhu al-Hijjah 1448Saturday 15 May 2027Sunday 16 May

Dates follow the Umm al-Qura calendar used in Saudi Arabia; each country announces the start of the month by moon sighting, so countries can differ by a day. The new moon before Ramadan falls on 6 February 2027, the day of an annular solar eclipse, so the crescent is not expected to be seen that evening. In 2028, Ramadan 1449 starts on Friday 28 January by the Umm al-Qura calendar.

Frequently asked questions

When does Ramadan 2027 start?

By the Umm al-Qura calendar, Ramadan 1448 starts on Monday 8 February 2027, with the crescent sought on the evening of Saturday 6 February (29 Sha'ban). The new moon falls on 6 February itself, so a sighting that evening is unlikely and Monday is the likely first day; each country's official announcement is final.

When is Eid al-Fitr 2027?

1 Shawwal 1448 by the Umm al-Qura calendar falls on Tuesday 9 March 2027, making Ramadan 29 days. If the crescent is not seen on the evening of Monday 8 March, Ramadan completes 30 days and Eid falls on Wednesday 10 March.

What are Ramadan working hours in the GCC?

UAE: normal hours cut by two hours a day for all private-sector workers. Saudi Arabia and Bahrain: 6 hours a day or 36 a week for Muslims. Oman: 6 hours a day or 30 a week for Muslims. Qatar: 6 a day and 36 a week for everyone. Kuwait: 36 hours a week for everyone.

When is Eid al-Adha 2027?

The Day of Arafat, 9 Dhu al-Hijjah 1448, falls on Saturday 15 May 2027 by the Umm al-Qura calendar, and Eid al-Adha on Sunday 16 May 2027, possibly a day later depending on each country's sighting.
